text: Over the past month has your child avoided eating situations because they said or indicated they were worried something bad might happen, like being sick, choking, having an allergic reaction, or being in pain while eating (for example, because they might be served something they usually avoid for these reasons, or because they have had a bad experience in the past)? Indicate how often your child has avoided eating situations due to such worries, ranging from 0 (= never) to 6 (= always).

Indicate how often your child has had physical feelings of panic or anxiety due to such thoughts, ranging from 0 (= never) to 6 (= always).
